title: Nasruddin Tale 170: The Tailor's Thimble
summary: A village tailor asked Nasruddin: "Mulla, what is the most indispensable tool in my shop?"...
full_text:
A village tailor asked Nasruddin: "Mulla, what is the most indispensable tool in my shop?"

"Your brass thimble," replied Nasruddin, "for it protects your fingers from the prick of your own needles, just as honest truth protects the soul from the sharp pricks of a guilty conscience!"
moral: Protect your fingers from sharp needles and your soul from sharp deceit.
